rpx_assign_economy_spirit = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = rpx_economy_health
				value = 80
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_ideas = rpx_economic_boom_spirit
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = rpx_economy_health
				value = 65
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_ideas = rpx_economic_upturn
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = rpx_economy_health
				value = 40
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		remove_ideas = rpx_economic_boom_spirit
		remove_ideas = rpx_economic_upturn
		remove_ideas = rpx_economic_downturn
		remove_ideas = rpx_economic_crisis
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = rpx_economy_health
				value = 25
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_ideas = rpx_economic_downturn
	}
	else = {
		add_ideas = rpx_economic_crisis
	}
}

rpx_econ_health_reward = {
	set_variable = {
		rpx_economy_health = {
			value = rpx_economy_health
			add = 3
		}
	}
	clamp_variable = {
		var = rpx_economy_health
		min = 0
		max = 100
	}
}

rpx_setup_economy_health = {
	set_variable_to_random = {
		var = rpx_economy_health
		min = 25
		max = 75
		integer = yes
	}
}

rpx_update_economy_health = {
	set_variable = {
		rpx_economy_health = {
			value = rpx_economy_health
			subtract = 2
		}
	}
	clamp_variable = {
		var = rpx_economy_health
		min = 0
		max = 100
	}
}
